subject: Cross-region co-sell dry-run — staggered handoff and contingency slots
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@cloudbridge.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-region co-sell dry-run — initial window proposals

Hi Karthik / Vanessa / Soojin,

Thanks again for partnering on the AWS marketplace co-sell dry-run next month. We'd like to run a full dress rehearsal that mirrors the customer-facing demo: LA-based sales lead handing off to APAC SI for technical deep-dive, with an AWS specialist on call. Goal is to validate runbook, timezones, and failover handoff.

Proposed windows (all times PT):
- Option A: Wed Oct 5, 08:00–09:30 PT (early APAC morning)
- Option B: Thu Oct 6, 13:00–14:30 PT (midday — overlaps EMEA)
- Option C: Fri Oct 7, 22:00–23:30 PT (late-night PT, early next day APAC)

Attached is a first-pass agenda (agenda-v1.docx). Can you confirm facilitator availability and whether Redwood can host a replay/test cluster for the SI to exercise failover? Also, can AWS confirm a short pre-call to validate account permissions?

Thanks,
Sean
-----
Sean Gallagher
Partnerships, CloudBridge Solutions
+1 415-555-0189
[Attachment: agenda-v1.docx (18KB)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-region co-sell dry-run — initial window proposals

Sean — thanks for the options and the agenda. We can do a dry-run that mirrors the customer flow; a staggered handoff is sensible so we can measure token latency and KV cache warmup across the handoff.

High-level thoughts:
- Favored slot: Option B (Thu Oct 6, 13:00–14:30 PT). It gives us reasonable regional overlap and avoids the overnight for most APAC SIs.
- Facilitators: I can host the initial 25–30 minutes (context + live demo). Vanessa — can you cover APAC SI handoff and run the failover script? Soojin — can you own recording + tagging of the runbook steps in Redwood Console?
- Test infra: we will provide a short-lived replay cluster and a runbook PDF. Attaching the dryrun_runbook.pdf (runbook includes checklist, test dataset, and rollback steps).
- Contingency: recommend a 30-minute contingency slot the following day (Fri Oct 7, 09:00–09:30 PT) in case we need to iterate.

Action items:
1) Vanessa & Soojin — confirm facilitator coverage and rehearsal availability (1-hour dry run prior).
2) Sean — confirm which CloudBridge SIs will attend and whether they need test creds.
3) Rita (AWS) — can your team spare an SA for a 15-minute pre-check on Oct 5?

I'll consolidate into a calendar invite once we have confirmations.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Partner Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dryrun_runbook.pdf (72KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-region co-sell dry-run — initial window proposals

Karthik — confirmed Option B works for me (Thu Oct 6). I can lead the APAC handoff and run the failover script, but I need Soojin to own recording and tagging as you noted. Marissa — can you availability-check for a focused 60-minute rehearsal the week prior? Prefer Tue Oct 3 or Wed Oct 4 afternoon PT.

Couple of clarifications inline — quoting your note: 
> "Contingency: recommend a 30-minute contingency slot the following day (Fri Oct 7, 09:00–09:30 PT)"
Yes — I like the contingency window, but suggest we make the primary invite a repeating calendar block with the contingency as an optional hold (so attendees can free up if the dry-run completes cleanly).

Also: we should include a quick checklist item in the runbook that verifies AWS role trust and that the SI test account has KV cache primed (that was the last friction point in our June run). I'll add a short paragraph to the runbook after this thread.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
